items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: I said that was Niki’s favorite song, he said well why don’t you call it that.

ctx.x: And here is some of this crazy music.

It was kind of fierce music in there, you know, some of it, well one of them was, that particular song, “A Wilder Alias,” and it had a lot of anger in it and stuff I think. But then there was other things that were softer. “Niki’s Song” was her favorite song and we did that, the one about the beach, it originally was called “A Full Moon” and then we changed it to “Niki’s Song.” Creed said we should do it. I said that was Niki’s favorite song, he said well why don’t you call it that. So that was on and that was…
Yeah well that’s not where you life was at right then, was it?
